# Jaari: Architecture

## Principles
1. Single owner, self-hosted, local-first.
2. Memory is git-backed Markdown that a human can read and fix (ADR-003).
3. Model proposes, policy disposes: external effects need owner approval bound to a digest (ADR-006).
4. Secrets never enter model context; only `secretRef` handles do (ADR-007).
5. A proactive message must earn the interruption (ADR-008).
6. Personality is enforced by a monitor, not just a prompt (ADR-008).
7. Plug and play: every external dependency sits behind a provider interface with a
   self-hosted default and hosted alternatives.
8. Untrusted content (email, web, documents) is read by a tool-less `reader` role first.
9. Approvals, spend, and digests are deterministic code, never an LLM.
10. `refs/` is reference only; openinstinct is a spec, never a code source (ADR-009).
11. Model proposes, policy disposes, for model choice too (ADR-011).
12. Cheapest capable option first: small model before large, http before browser.

## Packages
| Package | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `@jaari/core` | Agent loop on Pi, sessions, children, tool registry |
| `@jaari/llm` | Wraps `@earendil-works/pi-ai`; tiers + fallback chains, role routing, escalation, budgets, local-only privacy, usage log, `jaari llm eval` (ADR-011) |
| `@jaari/memory` | Git-backed memory repo, write path, canonicalize, daily audit, gap queue |
| `@jaari/persona` | Curiosity/Proactivity dials, monitor, quiet hours, notification ledger |
| `@jaari/gate` | Action digests, approvals, `audit.jsonl` |
| `@jaari/secrets` | `secretRef` storage and resolution for executors only |
| `@jaari/http` | Egress policy: blocks private ranges and cloud metadata, per-capability allowlists |
| `@jaari/web` | `web.search`, `web.fetch`, fetch escalation ladder (ADR-012) |
| `@jaari/computer` | Browser/desktop control via Playwright MCP or Stagehand, local profile or remote CDP, takeover (ADR-005, ADR-012) |
| `@jaari/channels` | `ChannelAdapter` contract and adapters |
| `@jaari/integrations` | GitHub, npm, PyPI, email |
| `apps/daemon` | Long-running process: scheduler, channels, jobs |
| `apps/cli` | `jaari init`, `jaari llm eval`, `jaari llm usage`, admin commands |

## Trust boundaries
- Owner ↔ channels: authenticated owner only (see OQ-02).
- Model ↔ tools: every tool maps to a capability; effectful capabilities go through the gate.
- Tools ↔ internet: all egress through `@jaari/http` or the container egress proxy.
- Untrusted content ↔ main session: `reader` summary only, never raw instructions.
